generation_policy: Contract-gated: generated only for previously uncovered L2 features with a nonblank L2 what contract; contract contents are treated as provisionally correct per user instruction.

feature.description: Support secure sign-in, sign-out, session establishment, reauthentication, recovery, session revocation, and suspicious-access visibility.

contract.purpose_user_function: Current code protects the local status API with a generated bearer token when required and guides authentication to external Codex/Claude CLI sessions; it does not implement Solar product-account sessions.
contract.valid_inputs: Loopback bearer token or injected X-Solar-Token/Authorization header; selected provider name; locally installed Codex/Claude CLI credential/session state; explicit login/reuse-host-credentials request.
contract.expected_outputs: Authorized/403 API response, provider auth-readiness JSON, device-login subprocess status, and recovery guidance without returning raw provider tokens.
contract.state_side_effects: Provider login can start a device-auth/setup-token subprocess and external CLI may store credentials; status server writes a local auth-token file and in-memory login-process status. GET auth/status is read-only.
contract.failure_rejection_behavior: Missing/wrong status token returns 403 where required; unsupported provider/login path or missing CLI returns explicit error; auth-expired panes/operators are blocked rather than silently rerouted.
contract.supported_boundaries_exclusions: Solar account sign-in/sign-out, password recovery, session inventory/revocation, and suspicious product-account access history were not found. Provider credentials are owned by external CLIs.
contract.granularity_atomic_contracts: API token absent/correct/incorrect; loopback versus NAT protection; provider authenticated/unauthenticated/expired; login start/status; unsupported provider/CLI missing; raw-secret non-disclosure; auth blocker prevents dispatch; distinguish provider session from product account.
contract.readme_product_docs: README.md: selected-runtime authentication and fail-closed routing; INSTALL.md: provider readiness and Settings > Runtime; docs/WINDOWS.md: WSL reachability/security boundary.
contract.cli_api_skill_interfaces: harness/lib/symphony/status-server.py: GET /auth/status, GET /auth/login/status, POST /auth/login, POST /auth/reuse-host-creds; codex login --device-auth or claude setup-token external CLI.
contract.config_schemas: harness/config/physical-operators.schema.json: auth mode, secret_ref and expose_raw_key_to_pane=false; harness/config/model-scenario-routing.json provider key references; no Solar user-session schema found.
contract.implementation_entrypoints: harness/lib/symphony/status-server.py: _authorized, _auth_status_payload, _auth_login_start, _auth_reuse_host_creds and StatusHandler; harness/lib/operator_flow_control.py auth-failure classification.
contract.platform_provider_limitations: Login launch is local-platform/runtime dependent; Windows runs through WSL/host credential reuse; provider trust/quota/auth semantics are external; no multi-user session service.

implementation.entrypoints: harness/lib/symphony/status-server.py: _authorized, _auth_status_payload, _auth_login_start, _auth_reuse_host_creds and StatusHandler; harness/lib/operator_flow_control.py auth-failure classification.
implementation.interfaces: harness/lib/symphony/status-server.py: GET /auth/status, GET /auth/login/status, POST /auth/login, POST /auth/reuse-host-creds; codex login --device-auth or claude setup-token external CLI.
implementation.schemas_and_config: harness/config/physical-operators.schema.json: auth mode, secret_ref and expose_raw_key_to_pane=false; harness/config/model-scenario-routing.json provider key references; no Solar user-session schema found.
